## Feature

- **bookmarks**: Press twice to remove a bookmark group *[commit by @Rongmario in 05ad007]*

## Bug Fix

- **config**: Mix-up between recipeBookmarksEnabled & autocraftingEnabled *[commit by @Rongmario in e110d8b]*
- **reload**: Ensure erroneous plugins aren't removed globally *[commit by @Rongmario in 0ed3bd5]*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/HadEnoughItems/compare/4.36.0...4.36.1

## Feature

- History grid from JEI Utilities *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #264]*
- **reload**: Warn about third-party plugin leaks on reload *[commit by @Rongmario in 318b280]*

## Bug Fix

- **bookmark**: Unwrap bookmarks when editing the blacklist in edit mode *[commit by @Rongmario in 173564f]*
- **bookmark**: Return the bookmarked ingredient from the bookmark overlay API *[commit by @Rongmario in 5b511c2]*
    *[Fixes issue #236 by @Cal-Is-Burning]*
- **bookmark**: Disallow dragging when bookmarks are disabled *[commit by @Rongmario in 34c65b3]*
    *[Fixes issue #234 by @Circulate233]*
- **reload**: Drop stale anvil and brewing caches on reload *[commit by @Rongmario in f8698e1]*
- **reload**: Reset the order tracker and string interner on full reload *[commit by @Rongmario in 638b109]*
- **reload**: Refresh the reused ingredient filter on recipes-only reload *[commit by @Rongmario in 63f3452]*
- **reload**: Build synchronous search indexes on full reload *[commit by @Rongmario in 49f9cee]*
- **reload**: Interrupt superseded search tree builds instead of waiting *[commit by @Rongmario in 1c85d9f]*
- **reload**: Finish the search tree build on full reload *[commit by @Rongmario in 01aaa04]*
- **reload**: Let the recipe search thread time out when idle *[commit by @Rongmario in 67b6947]*
- **reload**: Delete ingredient grid framebuffers when the runtime is replaced *[commit by @Rongmario in 91e1f3f]*
- **reload**: Clear stale filter listeners on recipes-only reload *[commit by @Rongmario in dc02c36]*
- **reload**: Unregister previous EnchantedBookCache on reload *[commit by @Rongmario in d04f890]*

## Refactor

- **ghost**: Pass the raw ingredient under the mouse to ghost dragging *[commit by @Rongmario in 2a325c0]*
- **bookmark**: Redirect bookmark focuses and unwraps through the helper *[commit by @Rongmario in fb0497a]*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/HadEnoughItems/compare/4.35.1...4.36.0
